info.title: YeahPay API (SG Transactions)
info.description: Based on YeahPay API Documentation (SG Transactions) 2.1. Request signatures use SHA-512. Join URL, appId, timestamp, version, nonce, the raw request body, and API key in that order with line feeds (ASCII 0x0A), then calculate the digest. The API key is used only for signing and is never sent in a request header.

post.description:
Create a PaymentIntent and return the Unified Checkout URL. Each call creates a new PaymentIntent. The merchant must have an approved Checkout access domain configured.

Checkout test Base URL: https://t-acquire-business.lepass.cn/gwp/checkout. Production Base URL: https://open-api.yeahpay.net/gwp/checkout. The sandbox endpoint is pending confirmation. The first signing line is /checkout/openapi/v2/getRedirectUrl, excluding the domain and /gwp.

post.description:
Create an embedded PaymentIntent from the merchant server. Ordinary new-card payments wait for buyer submission in the SDK. CIT/MIT requests with a valid consentToken initiate a charge during creation. Keep the API key and consentToken on the server; send only paymentIntentId and paymentIntentToken to the frontend.

Test endpoint: https://t-acquire-business.lepass.cn/gwp/checkout/openapi/v2/createIntent. The first signing line is /checkout/openapi/v2/createIntent, excluding the domain and /gwp. Production endpoint: https://open-api.yeahpay.net/gwp/checkout/openapi/v2/createIntent. The sandbox endpoint is pending confirmation. Use the common signing headers.

Send amount in JSON integer notation, never as a string, decimal, or scientific notation. Zero is only allowed for CIT new-card binding: customerId and CIT, without consentToken or buttonType. Only final_auth is supported; pre-authorization and subsequent capture are unavailable.

The same merchantId and requestId return the original PI without comparing new parameters or charging again. A different requestId with the same merchantOrderId returns 292003. Keep original business identifiers on retries. A direct-charge 292009, 500, or timeout may still follow creation or charging: query the original merchantOrderId first, and replay the original request if the original Token is needed. Replays do not replace the Token or extend Session validity. The default is 24 hours; use the actual Session expiry.

code=0 only means the request was processed; inspect data.status for payment results. Let the SDK handle PENDING and REQUIRES_CUSTOMER_ACTION. Frontend events and HTTP 200 are not proof of payment. Obtain a ready initial consentToken through a merchant query or verified success notification.

200.description: Check code for the business result, then data.status for the payment state

400.description: Malformed request; amounts must use integer notation

401.description: Merchant signature or application authentication failed

500.description: Internal error or uncertain result. Query with original business identifiers without charging again.

post.description:
Query a PaymentIntent from the merchant server within merchantId. Supply exactly one of paymentIntentId and merchantOrderId. The legacy orderId, requestId, and Session Token are not query keys.

Test endpoint: https://t-acquire-business.lepass.cn/gwp/checkout/openapi/v2/queryIntentStatus. The first signing line is /checkout/openapi/v2/queryIntentStatus, excluding the domain and /gwp. Production endpoint: https://open-api.yeahpay.net/gwp/checkout/openapi/v2/queryIntentStatus. The sandbox endpoint is pending confirmation. Use merchant OpenAPI signing, not a browser Session Token. This POST operation differs from the internal SDK GET /cashier/v2/queryIntentStatus.

code=0 means processed successfully; data.status is the overall PI state. Actions appear in latest_payment_attempt.nextAction, not at the top level. Merchant queries do not execute 3DS Continue. Let the SDK complete authentication with the original Token.

Does not issue paymentIntentToken or return refund totals, refundable balances, top-level customerId, or card. An initial consentToken is returned only when ACTIVE with complete credentials. If the PI succeeded but the reference is not ready, query the same PI later without binding or charging again. A valid original reference may also be returned for subsequent payments; its presence does not prove this payment succeeded.

292000 indicates invalid parameters; 292001 a missing or out-of-scope PI; 292003 an order ID creation conflict; 292004/292005 state or concurrency restrictions. 292009, 500, and timeouts require result confirmation. Keep the original order identifiers and continue querying instead of creating another charge.

VersionHeader.name: version
VersionHeader.description: Request version. The common parameter table specifies the fixed value 1.0. The 2.0 value in the signing example conflicts with that definition, so this specification uses 1.0.

SignatureHeader.name: signature
SignatureHeader.description:
SHA-512 signature. The signing text is `URL
appId
timestamp
version
nonce
raw request body
API key`.

paymentType.description: Payment type: scheduled for scheduled charges, unscheduled for unscheduled charges

merchantOrderId.description: Merchant order ID, unique within the current merchant

amount.description: Order amount in the smallest currency unit. Must be a JSON integer. This field determines the amount actually charged.

currency.description: Currency as three uppercase letters. Must be a payment currency enabled for the merchant.

checkoutMode.description: Checkout mode. Omit for a standard payment. PRE_AUTH creates a pre-authorization and requires the merchant to have pre-authorization permission. CONSENT_INITIAL is the initial payment of a Subscription Payment.

productType.description: Product type: PHYSICAL for physical goods, VIRTUAL for virtual goods

productList.description: Optional product list, up to 10 products by default. Used only for display on the Checkout page.

locale.description: Checkout page language. When omitted, it is determined by the merchant's region: zh-HK for Hong Kong merchants, en-US otherwise.

callbackUrl.description: Front-end return URL after payment. Must be an http or https URL.

notificationUrl.description: Payment result notification URL. Must be an http or https URL.

merchantLogo.description: Merchant logo URL shown on the Checkout page. Must be an https URL.

checkoutUrl.description: Checkout URL. The code defaults for both Session and short-link validity are 24 hours and can be overridden by environment configuration. Use the deployed configuration.

state.description: State or province, up to 64 characters

city.description: City; required for shipping and billing addresses

streetAddress.description: Non-blank street address, up to 256 characters

firstName.description: Buyer first name for this payment; does not create or update a customer profile

lastName.description: Buyer last name for this payment

EmbeddedCheckoutCustomer.description: Used when customerId is omitted. With customerId, the existing customer profile takes precedence and is not overwritten.

quantity.description: Product quantity as a positive JSON integer

unitPrice.description: Unit price as a positive JSON integer in the smallest currency unit

productImage.description: Product image; must be an HTTPS URL when provided

phone.description: Recipient phone; currently not projected into Session or downstream shipping data

productType.description: Product type; defaults to VIRTUAL when products and shipping are omitted

productList.description: Up to 10 display products. A non-empty list requires productType. The product total does not determine the amount charged.

phone.description: Billing phone; currently not returned or forwarded

EmbeddedCheckoutPaymentMethod.description: Billing prefill only. Does not accept card numbers or security codes and does not initiate payment. The SDK submits new-card payments.

authorization_type.description: Defaults to final_auth when omitted or null. pre_auth and subsequent capture are not supported.

paymentInitiator.description: Required for initial binding or when consentToken is supplied. Subsequent payments must match the original binding type.

consentToken.description: Active binding reference kept on the server. When supplied, createIntent immediately initiates a charge and amount must be positive. Never pass it to the browser.

buttonType.description: Button label for positive amounts; defaults to PAY. Omit for zero amounts, which display BIND. SUBSCRIBE does not create an automatic billing schedule.

locale.description: Checkout language: zh-CN, zh-HK, or en-US. Other values fall back to en-US.

returnUrl.description: HTTPS return URL, up to 1024 characters. Omitted or blank values use the approved merchant website. userInfo and fragments are not allowed.

notificationUrl.description: HTTPS notification URL, up to 1024 characters. Falls back to the application default order notification URL when omitted. userInfo and fragments are not allowed.

EmbeddedCheckoutCallback.description: Both return and notification URLs need a valid explicit value or default configuration. They are not interchangeable.

merchantId.description: Merchant ID within the appId permission scope

requestId.description: Creation idempotency key, up to 64 characters. Reuse for network retries. The same merchant and requestId return the original PI without comparing new parameters or charging again.

merchantOrderId.description: Merchant order ID, unique within the merchant. Reusing it with a different requestId returns a conflict.

amount.description: JSON integer in the smallest currency unit. Zero is only for CIT new-card binding without a charge. MIT, ordinary payments, and existing-Consent charges require a positive amount. Strings, decimals, and scientific notation are rejected.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, normalized to uppercase by the server; must be enabled for the merchant

payWay.description: Only Mastercard, case-insensitively. MASTER and whitespace are rejected. Omit or use null for available card brands. This filter does not validate the brand of an existing-Consent direct charge.

customerId.description: Platform customer ID, required for CIT/MIT binding and existing-Consent direct charges; also needed to show saved cards. This field alone does not initiate a charge.

deviceId.description: Non-blank device reference for positive-amount CIT direct charges with a valid consentToken only. Must match the buyer-side fingerprint reference. Rejected for ordinary payments, initial binding, or MIT. Reuse on retries.

paymentIntentId.description: PaymentIntent ID; supply exactly one of this and merchantOrderId

merchantOrderId.description: Original merchant order ID; supply exactly one of this and paymentIntentId. Do not use orderId.

bin.description: First six digits from the masked card record; returned only when available

last4.description: Last four digits from the masked card record

brand.description: Lowercase card brand, such as visa, mastercard, or amex

state.description: State or province, up to 64 characters

city.description: City; required for shipping and billing addresses

streetAddress.description: Non-blank street address, up to 256 characters

billing.description: Billing data saved for this attempt, returned only when available; not reconstructed from later customer profile changes

EmbeddedCheckoutCardSummary.description: Only available summary fields are returned. mask, expiry, issuer country, and PREPAID are not promised.

status.description: Status of the current authentication stage; COMPLETED does not mean payment succeeded

EmbeddedCheckoutNextAction.description: Actions appear only in latest_payment_attempt.nextAction. Let the SDK handle them with the original Token. Merchant queries do not execute Continue.

paymentAttemptId.description: Platform payment attempt ID, not an internal transaction order ID

createTime.description: Record time in the requested Accept-Timezone and service date format; do not append Z to a value without an offset

updateTime.description: Record time in the requested Accept-Timezone and service date format; do not append Z to a value without an offset

EmbeddedCheckoutAttempt.description: Latest payment attempt, omitted if none exists. Specific failure errorCode and errorMessage are not returned.

paymentIntentId.description: Platform-generated PaymentIntent ID; preserve the exact string

merchantOrderId.description: Original merchant order ID, always named merchantOrderId

amount.description: Creation amount; zero denotes card verification or binding, not a sale

status.description: Overall PI status. SUCCEEDED means a positive-amount payment or zero-amount card verification completed. Session expiry does not change the payment result.

consentToken.description: Server-side binding reference, returned when ACTIVE with complete downstream credentials. May appear later for initial bindings. Never expose to browsers or treat its presence as proof of payment.

createTime.description: Record time in the requested Accept-Timezone and service date format; do not append Z to a value without an offset

updateTime.description: Record time in the requested Accept-Timezone and service date format; do not append Z to a value without an offset

paymentIntentToken.description: Browser Session credential for this PI. Successful creation and replays return the original Token without extending its validity, even if it has expired.

availablePaymentMethods.description: Desktop estimate of card availability with a valid Session: card or an empty list. Empty for direct charges and possibly omitted without Session. The SDK Session determines final availability.

code.description: Business result code. Zero means processed successfully. HTTP 200 can still contain a business error.
